summary: ```# Introduction to New Features in Marvelous Designer 2025.1 - Pattern Generator (Beta) ## How to Create a New Fashion Style ### Step 1: Create a New Fashion Style 1. Click on the 2D version of the menu, then select the version of the designer. 2. Next, please select the clothing type. Currently, only the T-shirt is supported, and more options will be added later. ### Step 2: Select T-Shirt Style - According to the style you need, the style of the T-shirt is divided by the sleeve type. - At the bottom, you will see the basic measurement data of the clothing. ### Step 3: View and Adjust Measurement Data For how to view and adjust your measurement data, you have three different options: - **Regular Option**: Provides a complete list of common measurement points. - **Simple Option**: Provides the most common measurement points to simplify the editing process. - **User-Defined Option**: Allows you to customize your own measurement list and determine the measurement data according to your needs. ### Step 4: Select Clothing Versions - You can click on the eye icon to select which clothing versions you want to create. - You can switch the version to symmetrical or left-right symmetrical. - All measurement options can be used to display all measurement data of the version. ### Step 5: Detailed Information - Click on the Detailed Information button to display the list of all measurement information. - Select the measurement data that needs to be selected. ### Step 6: Finalize Measurement Settings After the setting is complete: 1. Click the button to change the application. 2. Enter your version measurement values. 3. You can click the reset button next to each measurement data to restore it to its original value. ### Additional Measurement Options - Some measurement items will contain a total length option used to enter the circumference of the front and back pieces. - Some measurement items also contain a pull-down option used to select the measurement location applied to the measurement data. ### Step 7: Create Clothing - Click the Create button to create clothing in the 2D and 3D windows. - You can also use the AI version generator to generate data. ## Using the AI Version Generator ### How to Generate AI Versions 1. Click the AI version generator button in the upper right corner of the version generator. 2. Enter the keyword to generate a picture or directly upload a picture to generate the result. 3. Select the clothing type and enter your draft inspiration. ### Tips for Effective AI Generation - Please make sure to add as many descriptive words as possible. - If you want to emphasize certain content, please put it in brackets. - Currently, only the T-shape can be selected, but later, more styles will be introduced. - A small tip: Please try to provide sentences that describe accurate words and avoid long sentences to produce more effective results. ### Keyword Suggestions - Click on the Keyword suggestion to display the power keywords to help you generate keywords. - Even if you use the same keyword, the AI picture will be recreated each time. Therefore, click on the Keyword button to update the keywords. - Keep the existing results as much as possible; according to the addition or change of keywords, the result may differ from the existing result. ### Finalizing Your Creation - Click on the Create button at random to add the power keywords to the text prompt at random. - Click on the Create button to create a picture. - Click the Clear button to clear all content to begin the creative process. - Click on the Upload button to add a reference image that aligns with the following guidelines: - Use a white background and black linebacker to ensure that the AI image has high quality. - Ensure that the image only contains the clothing image. This process can be repeated until you achieve the desired result. After creating the version, open the simulation and put the costume on the virtual model. That's all for this video. See you in the next video. ```
